summary: scripts/evidence-flip-ready counts a run that concluded cancelled as no evidence, neither an ok line nor a red, unless a job it judged failed; such runs are reported as cancelled_runs, which replaces superseded_red (a cancelled duplicate run of one head had read as fractal-web's hidden red)

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

schema.detail: The script's JSON report: superseded_red is gone and cancelled_runs lists every cancelled run without a failed judged job. Only the daily flip check reads it.

rules.detail: The gate decides as before; only the read-only flip trigger counts differently. A failed member, or the check's own failed job when it has no members, keeps a cancelled run red, and a timeout concludes the run failure.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; cancelled runs are judged by the superseded rule again.
